description: Canonical handoff contract for the Semantic Binding Package emitted by SBM to the Intent Signal Bridge.
invariants: Vocabulary invariants must remain visible in the handoff.
Drift flags must propagate without silent suppression.
The module-native SBM verdict must be mappable to CVSI.
downstream_requirement: IDE-2 uses the handoff to re-ground semantic output against the original M1 Governed Intent Graph and measure semantic displacement.
